messages:
maria: Starting a targeted access cleanup for infra and analytics projects. Goal: reduce admin entitlements that haven't been used in 120d and tidy KMS bindings before the external audit. Plan: owner notification -> 10d acknowledgement -> staged removals; include canary and rollback hooks.

henry: What's the exact stale threshold? 120d ok? Some data pipelines run quarterly.

vik: Recommend 120d by default, but add a whitelist for quarterly jobs. We'll surface candidates with last_api_call and last_console_login.

ops-bot: preflight: scanned 2,402 principals, 156 service accounts with admin-level roles, 34 KMS keys with non-owner ACLs. Low-risk bucket: 98 principals. Report: https://internal.ops/reports/access-clean-2439990000.

maria: Canary approach: pick 4 services across teams (infra-deploy, analytics-ingest, billing-export, user-metrics). For each, drop editor->viewer on non-owner bindings for 72h then revert if issues. Will monitor errors and job failures.

henry: Need safety net for KMS: ol' decryption probe before removing crypto bindings. If probe fails for a principal, mark as "needs-owner-review" not auto-remove.

vik: I'll generate CSV with columns: principal, role, last_seen, resource, kms_binding_flag, recommended_action. Will add an `exempt_reason` column.

maria: Runbook snippets for rollback: 1) `infra/tools/rbac-restore --batch <id>` 2) tag resources with `access-clean:rollback-<batch>` and a published audit log entry.

ops-bot: alert config: when canary removal triggers >3 failed jobs or >0.5% increase in 5xx across canary services, ping #eng-oncall and pause automation.

auditor: For external audit we'll need a snapshot of bindings prior to any removals and justification notes for each non-owner admin removed. Please keep snapshots immutable and store in the compliance bucket.

maria: Good point. We'll snapshot IAM bindings and KMS policies to gs://compliance-snapshots/access-clean-2439990000 and include owner pings in ticket history.

henry: Action items:
- henry: run decryption probes for listed KMS principals and flag failures
- vik: produce CSV + add quarterly job whitelist
- maria: create canary batches, snapshot bucket, owner ping template
- ops-bot: implement pause triggers and Slack webhook to #eng-oncall
ETA: Monday EOD for artifacts.

maria: Owner ping template (short): "Hi @team, we're running an access hygiene pass. The principal `<principal>` holds `<role>` on `<resource>` and hasn't been active in >120 days. Reply within 10 days to request exemption or we will remove the non-owner entitlement. For CI or scheduled jobs, set tag `access-clean:exempt=true` or open ticket /access/exempt. -security"

vik: I'll also include a column `reapply_playbook` with the exact gcloud command to restore if needed.

maria: Thanks everyone. Keep this thread for troubleshooting during the canary window. We will escalate any unexpected failures to incident response. :lock:
